root_cause: The pricing funnel was protected-merged to GitHub main, but Netlify production still served an older commit_ref. The content change was correct; the remaining failure was release transport drift between repository truth and provider production.
prevention_rule: A pricing or website release is not terminal after merge. When provider commit_ref differs from current main, use the canonical Production Source Snapshot transport and require bounded production release.json readback before marking the change live.

evidence.outcome: The promotion candidate changes only the canonical production snapshot workflow marker so the already-authorized exact-source transport executes from protected main.
evidence.production_readback: Pending protected merge, Netlify ready state, exact commit_ref match and public pricing functional readback.
